metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the tool in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It’s a dependency-free Node.js CLI that parses `.bib` and `.bst`, supports `--cites` and `--aux`, executes the BibTeX-style stack language, writes `.bbl` output, and emits the requested JSON log or error JSON on failure.

I sanity-checked the final artifact with `node --check` and end-to-end temporary runs against canonical styles including `plain.bst` and `alpha.bst`. No external `bibtex` 0.99c binary was available in this environment, so I could not do a direct byte-for-byte oracle comparison here.
